season.note: The third season of Love & Hip Hop: New York aired January 7 – April 15, 2013 on VH1, with 14 episodes plus this pre-season special.

episode.title: Love & Hip Hop Special — Season 3 Sneak Peek
episode.logline: An exclusive sneak peek at the upcoming Love & Hip Hop Season 3 — plus a behind-the-scenes look at the taping of Love & Hip Hop Atlanta.
episode.synopsis: Aired about five weeks before the Season 3 premiere, this special is the franchise's first look at the new-look New York cast. The third season rebuilt the show around Yandy Smith and Rich Dollaz, promoted Erica Mena to the main cast and brought in Winter Ramos, with Joe Budden, Consequence, Tahiry Jose, Raqi Thunda, Jen the Pen, Rashidah Ali and Olivia Longott filling out the ensemble. The special mixes sneak-peek footage with a behind-the-scenes visit to the Love & Hip Hop: Atlanta taping.
episode.whyItMatters: It is the earliest broadcast look at the season — the cast, the storylines and the tone five weeks before 'The Whole Truth and Nothing But the Truth' premiered on January 7, 2013.

announcement.note: VH1 announced the third season would return January 7, 2013 — three days after this special aired.

castRebuild.note: Rich Dollaz and Yandy Smith were the only major cast members carried over from seasons 1–2, with Yandy taking over as lead after Chrissy Lampkin's exit. Erica Mena was promoted to main cast and Winter Ramos joined.
